addingToWatchlist.p1: Adding media to your list is the core feature of Watcharr.
addingToWatchlist.p2: The homepage is where your list will appear once you have added something.
addingToWatchlist.p3: To get started, you can follow along with these steps to add your first movie (or show, etc):
addingToWatchlist.p4: If you prefer, you can also do this by clicking/tapping on the active poster again. This will take you to the contents full page. Here you can see all the options, including adding Thoughts for the content.
addingToWatchlist.p5: Thoughts can be anything you would like to write down or remember about the specific movie/show. For example, sometimes I like to write something specific that I really liked about the content.
addingToWatchlist.step1: Use the search bar at the top of the page to find content.
addingToWatchlist.step2: Hover or click on the content you want to add.
addingToWatchlist.step3: Clicking the + (Plus) icon will let you give the content a status.
addingToWatchlist.step3Statuses: Currently supported statuses include: Finished, Watching, Held, Planned, Dropped.
addingToWatchlist.title: Adding to your watchlist

handbook.intro1: Inside, you will find useful information in regard to using Watcharr.
handbook.intro2: Part of Watcharr's mission is to be extra user-friendly (aka intuitive), so hopefully you don't need to reference guides much, but they may come in handy, which is why this handbook was made.

jellyfinWebhook.configIntro: Configuration changes must be made to both Jellyfin and Watcharr to enable this feature. Each step in this guide will be prefaced with either (WATCHARR) or (JELLYFIN) to indicate in which application you are making the change.
jellyfinWebhook.done: Done! All you have to do now is go watch something on Jellyfin and see if it shows up in Watcharr automatically.
jellyfinWebhook.intro: The Jellyfin Webhook support in Watcharr allows for automatic tracking of new media as soon as it is started or completed in Jellyfin.
jellyfinWebhook.problemsP1: If you have any problems, the best place to start is by checking your server logs (Watcharr and Jellyfin).
jellyfinWebhook.problemsP2: For example, if Jellyfin server logs show 404 errors whenever it tries sending the webhook, it's likely you need to double check the Webhook Url in Jellyfin and ensure it is correct.
jellyfinWebhook.step1: (JELLYFIN) Install the Official Webhook plugin in Jellyfin.
jellyfinWebhook.step11: (JELLYFIN) Scroll to the bottom and click Save.
jellyfinWebhook.step1Detail: Simply go to your server dashboard, find the plugins store and look for one called Webhook and install it.
jellyfinWebhook.step1Which: If you see more than one Webhook plugin and don't know which to pick: Get the one from the Jellyfin Stable repository by the developer jellyfin.
jellyfinWebhook.step2: (JELLYFIN) Once the Webhook plugin is installed, you should see a settings button. Click it to enter the Webhook plugin settings.
jellyfinWebhook.step2Restart: If you were prompted to restart the Jellyfin server, you should do that. Then you'll see the Settings button in the Webhook plugin page.
jellyfinWebhook.step3: (WATCHARR) Go to your server configuration page, find the Jellyfin Webhook setting and toggle it ON.
jellyfinWebhook.step4: (WATCHARR) You will now see a new setting popup below the one you just toggled ON called Jellyfin Webhook Endpoint. Copy the address to your clipboard for the next step.
jellyfinWebhook.step5: (JELLYFIN) Click Add Generic Destination, then scroll down to the settings for the destination.
jellyfinWebhook.step6: (JELLYFIN) Set the Webhook Name to Watcharr (or anything you please).
jellyfinWebhook.step7: (JELLYFIN) Paste the address we copied from Watcharr into the Webhook Url field.
jellyfinWebhook.step7Note: Note: The full address copied from Watcharr may be wrong! Depending on how your server is configured, you may need to replace the hostname part of the address to one that your Jellyfin service can use to talk to your Watcharr instance.
jellyfinWebhook.step9: (JELLYFIN) Enable the users you want webhook events to be sent for.
jellyfinWebhook.title: Jellyfin Webhook Setup
